meta.title: Quantinuum H2, 32-ion GHZ parity versus analysis phase
meta.observable: Mean signed parity of the 32 measured bits
meta.datasetMember: ghz/data/GHZ_N32.json, nonadaptive theta1–theta32 shot strings with matched QASM
meta.license: Quantinuum’s repository reserves rights. The local table records factual measurements and circuit settings with source hashes.
meta.criterion: Signed-parity RMSE at most 0.15 across 16 held-out phase settings. Adjacent phase pairs alternate between calibration and holdout.
meta.drive: Two reference DAC slots encode digital rotation words: a virtual Z frame change Rz(−θ), then Ry(−π/2) on each ion. The nominal voltage scale and slot spacing describe this encoding.
meta.scope: Same-H2 analysis parity at the sampled fringe extrema using physical shots. Offset and in-phase contrast are identifiable; the independent sine quadrature is unobserved.
meta.traceObservable: Decoded signed Rz and Ry analysis words delivered by the reference DAC
